title: Akron Claims MAC Men's Indoor Track & Field Championship
desc: MOUNT PLEASANT, Mich. — The Akron Zips captured the 2026 MAC Men’s Indoor Track & Field Championship at Central Michigan University’s Jack Skoog Track. The victory marks the Zips' second-straight title as well as their 10th overall crown in program history, capping off a team effort that featured strong performances across multiple events. Head coach Kendra Reimer-Gonzales was recognized for Akron’s success, earning MAC Coach of the Year honors.
